blocks.text: Software engineering mein framework concepts, tareeqon (practices) aur tools ka ek standard aur reusable (baar baar istemal hone wala) set hai jo software applications banane ke liye ek structured foundation (tayyar bunyad / dhancha) deta hai. Framework pehle se bane hue components (hisse) aur architectures (banawat) deta hai jin se khaas software features banana aasan ho jata hai. Is tarah developers aam masloon ka hal dobara se banane (reinventing) ki bajaye sirf apni application ka khaas code likhne par dhyan dete hain. Frameworks kaam ko efficient, consistent (aik jaisa) aur code ko reusable banate hain, is liye software ki quality aur maintainability (aasani se theek aur update hona) behtar hoti hai.

Misal: Farz karein aap website banana chahte hain. Saara code shuru se likhne ki bajaye aap Django jaisa framework (websites ke liye) istemal kar sakte hain. Django mein user login, database management aur page templates jaise tayyar features hote hain. Yeh aisa hai jaise ghar banane ke liye sab kuch khud design karne ki bajaye pehle se bana hua naqsha (blueprint) istemal karna.

blocks.prompt: SDLC ke silsile mein framework ka kya kaam (role) hai? (Exercise MCQ 3)
blocks.explanation: Framework pehle se bane components aur architectures ke saath ek structured bunyad deta hai: option (b). Kitab ki answer key (c) 'To manage hardware' deti hai, jo is topic ke text se mel nahi khata.

items: Framework: concepts, practices aur tools ka standard, reusable set jo software banane ki tayyar bunyad deta hai.
Faida: tayyar components, kam mehnat, consistency, reusability; misal: Django (login, database, templates).
